profile.headline: Senior Staff Web Developer
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary:
Front- and back-end web developer. Strong emphasis in MVC design pattern and famiiliar with multiple frameworks. Proven ability in project management and history of providing deliverables on time. 

List of experience:
PHP (Symfony, CakePHP, Zend Framework)
Javascript (jQuery/Angular)
MySQL. MS-SQL, MongoDB
C/C++, Java, Android Development
HTML, CSS (Less/SASS)

Specialties: Web Development

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Web development and technical consulting. Primarily focused on Full Stack Web Development utilizing PHP, MySQL, and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) running on Red Hat/CentOS distributions, projects under the SolidCoding banner include one off consulting projects, ongoing consulting projects, and personal projects. Projects are either hosted on VPS instances that I maintain or AWS EC2/Elastic Beanstalk instances, where S3/RDS/DynamoDB/SES are used.

On the front-end, most projects use some combination of jQuery, SASS/CSS, and Bootstrap and source code is maintained in Git/GitHub repositories. Projects are managed with Phabricator/Trello.

Some projects involved custom Wordpress and vBulletin development, including building custom plugins, theme modifications, and cross-platform integration solutions tailored according to client needs.

In addition to the listed technologies are actively maintained projects in C# .NET and the Android mobile app, Sojournal. Please see my Projects section for examples.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Lead Full Stack Web Developer for internal and public facing web applications. Developed a scalable online survey framework with over 1 million survey participant accounts that supports dynamic skip patterns, is mobile optimized and has been tested for Section 508 compliance.

Built internal project management application that supports multiple isolated environments. Projects can be shared across environments. Features include a rich commenting system, presentation tooling, diff highlighter, and a committee reviews system among other features

Active management of on-premise servers as well as AWS EC2 Linux instances (CentOS) and milCloud virtual servers (Windows Server), including MariaDB database cluster

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Senior Full Stack Web Developer and team lead for web applications supporting Military Population Health studies at Naval Health Research Center. Projects utilize a combination of technologies including:  PHP, CakePHP, MySQL/MariaDB, Javascript/jQuery/Angular, CSS/SASS, React Native (Mobile app development). Projects and tasks are managed on Slack and Asana.

Roles/Projects include:
- Create and manage front facing public websites and complex, dynamic online surveys that collect data from hundreds of thousands of participants. Surveys are responsive, mobile-friendly, and include features such as Save & Continue and the ability to backtrack and change responses, which in turn may influence other major parts of the survey. 
- Internal project management application for tracking project status, managing team rosters, version control of documents, and facilitating team review processes, among other features
- Due to data restrictions on external services (for example, unable to use Mailchimp for Email Marketing), built a custom Email Campaign Platform for editing email templates, curating mailing lists, processing bounce and undeliverable emails, tracking views/clicks, and handling unsubscribe requests
- Actively manage physical servers hosted at a colocation facility as well as AWS EC2/RDS Instances on GovCloud
- Mobile App prototype built using React Native for the Millennium Cohort Study that interfaces with a CakePHP powered API

projects.title: Operation Sports
projects.description: Lead web developer for Operation Sports, a news and content provider focused on the sports video games industry with over 900,000 users.

projects.title: Novel Trackr
projects.description:
NovelTrackr is a web app I put together to help me keep track of web novels that I am reading. These can be translated novels (of Japanese, Korean, or Chinese origin), or original English web novels. The application allows users to add novels to their reading list from a database and bookmark the chapters they are on. At the user's request, daily summaries of new releases on their list are sent out. The data is sourced from the Reddit subreddits /r/lightnovels and /r/noveltranslations using the Reddit API. 

The CSS used for the site is based on the same modified AdminLTE package used by Custom PC Review Build and the site runs on the Symfony PHP framework with a MySQL backend.
